# NTLM Hash Support Checklist: Requirements Quality

**Purpose**: Reviewer-authored requirements-quality checklist for the NTLM hash support feature, covering security & crypto correctness, config & mismatch semantics, index metadata & migration, backward compatibility, and output/summary/docs. This validates the *requirements* (spec, plan, data-model, contracts), not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-10-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the allowed values and default for the hash-type setting specified for every configuration surface (environment variable, CLI flag, config schema)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001/§FR-009, Contracts §HASH_TYPE] — resolved: the config surface is environment variables; `contracts/config.md` defines `HASH_TYPE` (`auto` default, `sha1`, `ntlm`) and `HASH_TYPE_MISMATCH` (`error` default, `warn`) with values and defaults. No CLI flag is introduced for this option (by design).
- [x] CHK002 Is the precedence between an explicit hash type and a detectable corpus explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions] — resolved: Assumptions state an explicit value always overrides detection; `auto` uses content detection.
- [x] CHK003 Are the hashing and encoding requirements fully specified for each active hash type (SHA-1 vs NTLM)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002] — resolved: FR-002 defines SHA-1 (existing) vs NTLM = MD4 of UTF-16LE password, uppercase hex.
- [x] CHK004 Are output requirements complete for every output format (CSV, JSON) and for the console/dry-run summary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010/§FR-011] — resolved: FR-010 covers CSV column + JSON property + console summary; FR-011 covers dry-run summary and selection source.
- [x] CHK005 Are documentation requirements enumerated for every surface (README, example environment file, CLI help)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013] — resolved: FR-013 names README, example env file, and CLI help.
- [x] CHK006 Is the `.idx` header change specified with all required fields (version marker, hash type, file size, mtime)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Data-model IndexMetadata] — resolved: FR-008 + data-model v2 header (sorted flag, version marker, hash type, mtime, file size).

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "self-correct" precisely defined (what is changed, what is recorded, and what is reported)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007] — resolved: FR-007 defines self-correction (effective type + password hashing), the recorded per-record hash-type field, and the requested-vs-effective reporting; edge case "Self-corrected run visibility".
- [x] CHK008 Is "confident/consistent detection" quantified so implementations cannot diverge? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007/§Assumptions] — resolved: FR-007 now defines confident detection as an unambiguous single mapping {40→sha1, 32→ntlm} (file) / {35→sha1, 27→ntlm} (split-dir) and requires abort on mixed/no-sample.
- [x] CHK009 Is "prominent warning" defined with observable or measurable criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007] — resolved: FR-007 defines it as a stderr line + console-summary echo naming requested and detected/effective types.
- [x] CHK010 Is the notice required for API-mode auto→SHA-1 resolution specified with its content and channel? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006] — resolved: FR-006 + contracts/config.md define stderr + summary, content, and the `HASH_TYPE=ntlm` hint.
- [x] CHK011 Is "unreadable/ambiguous corpus" defined with concrete conditions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Edge Cases] — resolved: FR-007 defines ambiguous as any length outside the known set, a corpus exhibiting both lengths, or no non-empty sample; Edge Cases cover empty/unreadable directories.
- [x] CHK012 Is the first-non-empty-line sampling rule unambiguous about the separator, blank lines, and CRLF/LF? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Edge Cases] — resolved: FR-012 defines length before the separator; Edge Cases define CRLF/LF and blank-line handling.
- [x] CHK013 Are the terms requested/detected/effective/corrected hash type used consistently across documents? [Clarity, Data-model HashTypeConfig] — resolved: data-model consolidates to a single canonical `ActiveHashInfo` (`requested`, `type`, `source: 'explicit'|'detected'|'corrected'`); `HashTypeConfig` removed.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK014 Do FR-006 (auto default) and the API-mode assumption align without contradiction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006/§Assumptions] — resolved: both state `auto` applies to local corpora and resolves to SHA-1 behavior with a notice in API mode.
- [x] CHK015 Are the detection-length rules consistent between the spec and the data model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Data-model CorpusFormat] — resolved: FR-012 and data-model both use full 40/32 and suffix 35/27.
- [x] CHK016 Do FR-007, the Edge Cases list, and SC-007 agree on mismatch handling? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007/§SC-007] — resolved: all three defer to FR-007's error/warn semantics; SC-007 references FR-007.
- [x] CHK017 Are the hex-casing requirements self-consistent (uppercase generation vs case-insensitive matching)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Edge Cases] — resolved: FR-002 generates uppercase hex; Edge Cases require case-insensitive matching of upper/lower-case corpus hex.
- [x] CHK018 Do the output requirements (FR-010) conflict with the SC-002 claim of results identical to current behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010/§SC-002] — resolved: SC-002 now scopes "identical" to leak verdicts and counts, explicitly excluding the added hash-type field required by FR-010.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 Can SC-001 (100% of planted passwords correct, 0 cross-type matches) be objectively verified from the defined fixtures? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001] — resolved: T010 fixtures (NTLM single-file/split-dir + equivalent SHA-1 corpus) and T011 verify planted counts and zero cross-type matches.
- [x] CHK020 Is "identical to current behavior" for default runs measurable, and against which baseline is it compared? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] — resolved: baseline is the existing SHA-1 fixtures/pre-feature behavior; SC-002 now specifies verdicts/counts; T012 asserts equality.
- [x] CHK021 Is the NTLM bounded-memory expectation quantified with a concrete threshold? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006] — resolved: SC-006 expresses the invariant "no full-corpus load, parity with SHA-1"; T044 adds a bounded-memory test (peak RSS/allocation bound). A fixed byte threshold is intentionally not asserted because the streaming buffer is bounded and independent of corpus size.
- [x] CHK022 Is SC-007's "identical to a correctly-configured run" objectively comparable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007] — resolved: T036 compares a `warn`-mode self-corrected run against an explicitly-correct-configured run for equality.

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are the primary single-file NTLM scan requirements complete? [Coverage, Spec §US1/§FR-003] — resolved: FR-003 covers NTLM single-file across all read modes (auto/sequential/binary/index); US1 scenario 1.
- [x] CHK024 Are the split-prefix directory NTLM requirements complete across all read modes? [Coverage, Spec §US1.3/§FR-004] — resolved: FR-004 covers NTLM split-prefix suffix files (27 chars); US1 scenario 3.
- [x] CHK025 Are the HIBP API NTLM requirements defined for both request formation and local matching? [Coverage, Spec §US2/§FR-005] — resolved: FR-005 covers NTLM range requests (5-char prefix) and local 27-char suffix matching.
- [x] CHK026 Are exception-flow requirements defined for an invalid hash-type configuration before any I/O begins? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009/§SC-004] — resolved: FR-009 + SC-004 require rejection before reading/hashing/scanning.
- [x] CHK027 Are recovery/rebuild requirements defined for stale or invalidated indexes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008] — resolved: FR-008 requires automatic invalidation and rebuild on type/size mismatch or legacy header.
- [x] CHK028 Are requirements covering each selection path (explicit, detected, corrected) present? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011] — resolved: FR-011 + `ActiveHashInfo.source` cover explicit/detected/corrected.
- [x] CHK029 Is the API-mode auto-resolution covered as a distinct flow including its notice? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006] — resolved: FR-006 defines the auto→SHA-1 API resolution and its notice; US3/quickstart scenario 6.

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK030 Are Unicode/non-ASCII password requirements defined and required to be cross-platform consistent? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases] — resolved: Edge Cases require UTF-16LE NTLM hashing consistent across platforms.
- [x] CHK031 Is empty-password filtering explicitly required to remain hash-type-independent? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases] — resolved: Edge Cases require empty passwords filtered before hashing regardless of type.
- [x] CHK032 Are malformed-line handling requirements defined for both full-hash and suffix modes? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases] — resolved: Edge Cases require an explicit error for lengths that are neither the expected full nor suffix length.
- [x] CHK033 Are same-path (mtime-preserving) corpus swap requirements defined? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases/§FR-008] — resolved: Edge Cases + FR-008 require validating recorded hash type and size, not just mtime.
- [x] CHK034 Is the "password present in both corpora" scenario addressed? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases] — resolved: Edge Cases require matching only the active run's type; covered by T015.
- [x] CHK035 Are requirements for 5–10× dataset growth defined for NTLM? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases/§SC-006] — resolved: Edge Case "Very large corpora" + SC-006 require the existing streaming/bounded-memory guarantees to hold and survive growth.
- [x] CHK036 Is the zero/unreadable/no-sample state for split-prefix directories defined? [Coverage, Gap, Spec Edge Cases] — resolved: FR-007 (no non-empty sample ⇒ abort) + Edge Case "Auto-detection with no readable data".
- [x] CHK037 Is the behavior for mixed hash types within a single corpus specified? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-007] — resolved: FR-007 classifies mixed lengths within one corpus as a data-integrity error that aborts in both modes.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK038 Is the privacy invariant (only the 5-character prefix leaves the machine) stated and measurable for NTLM? [NFR-Security, Spec §FR-005/§US2.2] — resolved: FR-005 + US2 scenario 2 require only the 5-char prefix to be transmitted.
- [x] CHK039 Are no-plaintext-unless-opted-in requirements defined for NTLM outputs? [NFR-Security, Spec §FR-010] — resolved: FR-010 forbids writing plaintext unless the user explicitly opts into including secrets.
- [x] CHK040 Are requirements present forbidding weakening of the crypto environment and use of untrusted dependencies? [NFR-Security, Spec §Assumptions] — resolved: Assumptions forbid weakening the crypto environment and untrusted dependencies; plan implements self-contained MD4.
- [x] CHK041 Is NTLM hashing correctness pinned to reference vectors within the requirements? [NFR-Correctness, Spec §Assumptions, quickstart.md] — resolved: Assumptions require reference-vector verification; quickstart.md lists the vectors used by T002.
- [x] CHK042 Are NTLM streaming/bounded-memory requirements stated at parity with SHA-1? [NFR-Performance, Spec §SC-006] — resolved: SC-006 + Edge Case "Very large corpora" require parity with SHA-1 streaming guarantees.

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK043 Is the external NTLM corpus format and the user's acquisition responsibility documented? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions] — resolved: Assumptions define the standard HIBP NTLM format and place acquisition on the user.
- [x] CHK044 Is the Node ≥26 / MD4 availability assumption documented and validated as a dependency? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan Technical Context] — resolved: plan Technical Context records the validation (Node 26/OpenSSL 3 has no `md4`) and the self-contained resolution.
- [x] CHK045 Is the single-hash-type-per-run scope boundary, including the exclusion of dual-hash reporting, stated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — resolved: Assumptions state one hash type per run and exclude per-run dual-hash reporting.

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK046 Is unqualified MD4 acceptable in FIPS/compliance contexts, or is a compliance caveat required? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002, Plan] — resolved: MD4 is used only as the NTLM wire-format hash for HIBP compatibility, implemented self-contained in `src/crypto/md4.ts` (no legacy provider, no dependency). It is not used for at-rest protection; FIPS operators are out of scope (documented in plan/research).
- [x] CHK047 Is the index header byte layout unambiguous, including endianness and the version-marker value? [Ambiguity, Data-model IndexMetadata] — resolved: `IDX_HEADER_SIZE = 19`; byte 0 sorted flag (`IDX_SORTED_FLAG_OK`), byte 1 version marker `IDX_VERSION_V2 = 0x02`, byte 2 hash type (0/1/2), bytes 3–10 mtime (BigInt64LE), bytes 11–18 size (BigUInt64LE).
- [x] CHK048 Is the "mtime newer" freshness check unambiguous relative to the "type/size equal" check? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008, Data-model IndexMetadata] — resolved: v2 header iff file size matches v2 layout AND marker == 0x02; hash type and file size MUST be equal; index mtime MUST be >= file mtime; any failure → stale/rebuild.

## Traceability

- [x] CHK049 Is a requirement/acceptance-criteria ID scheme defined, with success criteria mapping to functional requirements? [Traceability, Spec §FR-014] — resolved: FR-###, SC-###, and CHK### schemes; success criteria reference functional requirements (e.g. SC-007 → FR-007).
- [x] CHK050 Do all edge cases trace to a functional requirement or success criterion, or are gaps flagged? [Traceability, Spec Edge Cases] — resolved: Edge Cases reference FR-008/FR-010/FR-011/SC-006, and detection edge cases are covered by FR-007/FR-012.
